### 🟡 Changes recommended Provider lookup can fail after remote URL normalization or select the wrong repository for nested paths, producing empty or unrelated PR diffs.
2 open issues - [Use the normalized repository URL for PR registration keys](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-pull-request-github/pull/9190#discussion_r4555418474) · New - [Preserve the originating repository root for PR diff lookups](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-pull-request-github/pull/9190#discussion_r4555418534) · New
What changed in this PR This PR addresses #9179 by making “Open Changes” resolve PR content within the correct repository in multi-root workspaces. Reload restoration and the approve/resolve behavior in #8969 remain outside its scope. **Changes:** - Select repository folders by PR document path rather than shared remote names. - Key content providers by remote URL and PR number, with registration-scoped disposal. - Add multi-root regression coverage and adapt existing provider registrations. | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | `src/​view/​treeNodes/​pullRequestNode.ts` | Pass the PR model when registering content providers. | | `src/​view/​reviewManager.ts` | Update review content registration to pass the PR model. | | `src/​view/​inMemPRContentProvider.ts` | Scope provider keys and lookup by repository; guard disposal. | | `src/​test/​view/​submoduleChanges.test.ts` | Adapt fixtures and registrations to the new signature. | | `src/​test/​view/​inMemPRContentProvider.test.ts` | Test independent reads and disposal for equal PR numbers. | | `src/​test/​github/​repositoriesManager.test.ts` | Test path-based selection with shared or missing remote names. | | `src/​github/​repositoriesManager.ts` | Remove remote-name-first selection for PR documents. |
Review effort: Balanced

review_comments.body: If a cached PR predates `resolveRemote()` changing an SSH URL to the HTTPS `clone_url`, registration uses the PR's captured URL while `readFileWithProvider` uses the repository's current URL. The keys differ even after lazy registration reuses that model, leaving diffs empty. Derive the registration key from `pr.githubRepository.remote.url`, update the PR test fixtures, and add a regression covering remote normalization after model creation.

For a parent PR changing `vendor/library/src/file.ts`, an open nested repository at `vendor/library` makes `getManagerForFile` select the child rather than the parent. This lookup then misses the registered parent provider and uses the child's remote and PR number, producing empty or unrelated diffs. Preserve the originating repository root in PR URIs and use it for both cached reads and lazy registration, with a nested-repository regression test.
